items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Big Sid Catlett' and the interviewee does not claim to have worked with, met, or known him personally, only acknowledging the name in the context of the interviewer's statement.

ctx.x: And 3ig Sid Catlett. It's a beautiful rendition of that, I'd like to take that and keep it for my file always.
